items.title: 3.1.4 Polyatomic ions mein phaila hua octet (expanded octet) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.1.4, printed pages 49-50, with Quick Check 3.2.

blocks.text: Polyatomic ions woh ions hain jo ek se zyada qism ke atoms se bane hon. In ka formal charge un par kul (net) charge hai, jo bond banne ke baad un ke valence shells ke electrons gin kar nikala jata hai. Ammonium ion (NH₄⁺) ko chhor kar yeh ions aksar negative charge rakhte hain, maslan carbonate (CO₃²⁻), sulfate (SO₄²⁻) aur nitrate (NO₃⁻) ions. Kuch polyatomic ions mein beech wala (central) atom apni electron density oonche orbitals tak phaila kar octet rule tor deta hai. Aise ions ko expanded octet (phaila hua octet) wala kehte hain. Mashhoor misalein SO₄²⁻, ClO₄⁻ aur PO₄³⁻ hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne nitrate ion ko NO₃³⁻ likha hai. Nitrate par sirf ek negative charge hai: N (+5) aur teen O (har ek −2) mil kar +5 − 6 = −1. Is liye sahi NO₃⁻ hai.

blocks.alt: Sulfate ion ki Lewis structure, chakor brackets mein, oopar daen taraf 2- charge. Darmiyan mein sulfur, oopar aur neeche wale oxygen atoms se double bonds aur baen aur daen wale oxygen atoms se single bonds. Har double bond wale oxygen par do lone pairs aur har single bond wale oxygen par teen lone pairs. Brackets ke andar 'sulfate ion' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Sulfate ion ki Lewis structure (kitab mein matan ke saath chhapi structure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beech wale S ke gird electrons ginein: do double bonds (2 × 4 = 8 electrons) aur do single bonds (2 × 2 = 4 electrons), kul 12. Yeh octet (8) se chaar zyada hain; isi ko expanded octet kehte hain. Brackets ke bahar 2− poore ion ka charge hai.
SO₄²⁻ ki Lewis structure se hum beech wale S atom ke gird electrons gin sakte hain.
S atom ke valence shell ke electrons is tarah gine jate hain:

blocks.latex: \text{No of valence electrons} = 2 \times (\text{double bond electrons}) + 2 \times (\text{single bond electrons})
blocks.text_alt: No of valence electrons = 2 × (double bond electrons) + 2 × (single bond electrons)

blocks.text: Yani S ke valence shell mein 12 electrons hain, octet se 4 zyada. Octet ka yeh phailao bonding mein d orbital ke shamil hone se hota hai, jo extra electrons rakh sakta hai. Akele (neutral) S(0) atom ki configuration mein p orbitals mein sirf do unpaired (akele) electrons hain. Khali d orbitals ki wajah se electrons upar ja kar zyada unpaired electrons bana sakte hain. Isi se S ki mukhtalif oxidation states bhi samajh aati hain aur yeh bhi ke S apne d orbital mein extra electrons le sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka text kehta hai ke 3p pair ka ek electron 3d mein ja kar 4 unpaired electrons banata hai (3s² 3p³ 3d¹; yeh haalat SO₂ mein kaam aati hai). Lekin kitab ke neeche chhape boxes mein ek 3s electron bhi 3d mein gaya hai, is liye 6 unpaired electrons hain (3s¹ 3p³ 3d²). Sulfate mein S chhe bonds banata hai, is ke liye 6 unpaired electrons chahiye, to boxes sulfate ke liye sahi hain.

blocks.alt: Sulfur ke orbital dabbon (boxes) ki do qataarein, har ek mein ek 3s, teen 3p aur paanch 3d dabbe. Oopar wali qataar: 3s mein do ulte teer (jora), 3p mein ek jora aur do akele oopar teer, 3d khaali. Neeche wali qataar: 3s mein ek oopar teer, har 3p dabbe mein ek oopar teer, aur pehle do 3d dabbon mein ek ek oopar teer.
blocks.caption: Sulfur ke electron dabbe: electrons ke promotion se pehle aur baad 3s, 3p aur 3d orbitals (kitab ke chhape box diagrams ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar wali line S ki ground state hai: 3p mein sirf do unpaired electrons. Neeche wali line mein electrons khali 3d orbitals mein chale gaye hain, aur ab chhe unpaired electrons hain (3s¹ 3p³ 3d²), jo chhe bonds bana sakte hain.
Isi tarah hum tri-iodide ion mein beech wale iodine atom ke gird valence electrons gin sakte hain. Is ion ki Lewis structure yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Tri-iodide ion ki Lewis structure: teen iodine atoms ek seedh mein, I-I-I, do single bonds se jure hue. Har iodine atom par teen lone pairs. Structure chakor brackets mein hai aur oopar daen taraf minus charge.
blocks.caption: Tri-iodide ion, [I3]-, ki Lewis structure (kitab mein chhapi structure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Beech wale atom ke valence electrons is tarah gine jate hain:

blocks.latex: \text{No of valence electrons} = 2 \times (\text{no. of single bond electrons}) + 2 \times (\text{no. of lone pairs})
blocks.text_alt: No of valence electrons = 2 × (no. of single bond electrons) + 2 × (no. of lone pairs)

blocks.text: Tri-iodide ion (I₃⁻) ke beech wale iodine ke valence shell mein 10 electrons hain, yani octet do electrons se phail gaya hai.

blocks.caption: Beech wale atom ke electrons ginna
header: Beech wale atom par bonds aur lone pairs

blocks.prompt: a) Kya periodic table ke period 2 ke elements ka octet phail sakta hai? Kyun ya kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Period 2 ke atoms (C, N, O, F) ke paas sirf 2s aur 2p orbitals hain, d orbitals nahi, is liye woh aath se zyada valence electrons nahi rakh sakte.

blocks.prompt: c) ClO₃⁻ aur PO₄³⁻ mein expanded octet ka andaza lagayein aur samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Cl aur P period 3 mein hain aur un ke paas khali 3d orbitals hain. ClO₃⁻ mein Cl do double bonds (8 electrons), ek single bond (2) aur ek lone pair (2) rakhta hai: kul 12 electrons. PO₄³⁻ mein P ek double bond (4) aur teen single bonds (6) rakhta hai: kul 10 electrons. Dono octet (8) se zyada hain. (Kitab mein Quick Check ka hissa b chhapa nahi.)

items: Polyatomic ions mein ek se zyada qism ke atoms hote hain; aksar negative (NH₄⁺ alag hai). Period 3 ya aage ka beech wala atom d orbitals ki madad se octet phaila sakta hai: SO₄²⁻ mein S ke 12, I₃⁻ mein I ke 10 valence electrons.
